dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary macro-annuli are visible on the dorsal surface: a large, irregular 'C' shape on the posterior-dorsal flank with a sharp, high-contrast jagged perimeter; a central smaller 'O' shape with a continuous high-intensity boundary; and a complex, multi-segmented 'C' cluster on the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of solid high-intensity light pixels are distributed in low density, primarily occupying the interstitial spaces between the larger annular structures along the dorsal midline and appearing as discrete points near the lower lateral light-saturation zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the posterior 'C', the central 'O', and the anterior 'C' cluster form a longitudinal, obtuse scalene triangle that tracks the anatomical curvature of the dorsal ridge.
